sections.heading: Overview
bullets: Wing 7's capstone fight — a tether/pylon defense system layered under a normal DPS race, across 6 phases. One of the harder coordination checks in the raid roster; 12-minute enrage.

sections.heading: Pylons & tethers
bullets: Qadim starts the fight holding all the pylons, which form his invulnerability shield. Three Pylon Kiters break each pylon's breakbar and tether to it (via the Flux Disruptor action key) to strip that protection.
<mark>Battering Blitz</mark> is Qadim rushing at and destroying a pylon directly — stop him before he reaches one. If a pylon does get repossessed, he regains the shield and knocks everyone back.

Good Tether stacks (on Qadim) increase his damage taken 5% per stack, up to 50% at 10 stacks. Bad Tether reduces the affected player's outgoing damage — the tank and kiters manage the main tethers, but they can spread to up to 3 more players each, so don't let them go unmanaged.

sections.heading: Force of Havoc & Ruinous Nova
bullets: <mark>Force of Havoc</mark> ("the carpet"): a wave of energy that leaves a persistent damage field along its path — if it crosses a pylon, Qadim takes its power (repossession). The tank steers it away from the squad and away from pylons.
In phase 1, Qadim channels Ruinous Nova until every pylon breakbar is broken — miss it and it's a squad wipe.

sections.heading: Fire split (80% / 60%)
bullets: <mark>Shatter</mark> lifts the whole squad and drops fire circles beneath everyone — the squad typically stacks on a predetermined pylon side for this so the drop is coordinated rather than chaotic.

sections.heading: Anomalies & other mechanics
bullets: From 75% health, Anomaly adds spawn from orb points every 30-40s (faster in later phases) — they have breakbars and can be soloed by a Druid or handled with CC. Ones standing on a player-cast fire die on their own; any that reach Qadim need to be killed directly.
<mark>Caustic Chaos</mark> is the debuff that increases incoming damage if it stacks up — don't ignore it.
Also watch for: Skyhammer (expanding lightning circle on a random non-tank), Arrow (unblockable tracking missile), and timed Orbs that kiters need to catch mid-air.

sections.heading: Enrage
bullets: 12:00 — Qadim deals +200% damage past this point.
